data.narrative:
Sift Stack is a Series B artificial intelligence and software company founded by Karthik Gollapudi and Austin Spiegel, having raised $67M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 private frontier-tech firms at the same stage—including Scale AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI—plus one public peer (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis anchors to the $67M total raised and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $127M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI), producing a median of $4.4B. The dispersion reflects meaningful heterogeneity in market positioning and investor appetite within frontier AI at this stage.

Synthesizing these approaches yields a triangulated valuation range of $108M (low) to $5.1B (high), with a median of $2.3B. The wide range reflects two competing data signals: stage-progression anchored to capital invested versus peer multiples in a high-variance sector. Key uncertainties include whether Sift Stack's product traction and unit economics more closely resemble lower-valuation or higher-valuation peers, and the stability of peer multiples given ongoing AI market repricing. Determining position within this $108M–$5.1B range requires assessment of customer concentration, revenue growth, and competitive moat depth.
